subject_uz: Markaziy bank Farg'ona viloyat boshqarmasi binosidagi isitish, sovutish va havo almashtirish tizimining yaroqsiz qismlarini yangisiga almashtirib kapital ta'mirlash

requirements.summary_uz: Uskunalarni yetkazib berish va kapital ta'mirlash ishlari tasdiqlangan loyiha-smeta hujjatlari asosida bajariladi.
requirements.summary_en: Equipment supply and the major repair are done according to the approved design and estimate documents.
requirements.quote: Uskunalarni yetkazib berish va kapital ta'mirlash ishlari tasdiqlangan loyiha-smeta hujjatlari asosida amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Ma'muriy binolarda muhandislik tizimlariga texnik xizmat ko'rsatish bo'yicha kamida uch yillik ish tajribasi (xat bilan) talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: At least three years of experience maintaining engineering systems in administrative buildings (stated in a letter).
requirements.quote: bo'yicha kamida uch yillik ish tajribasiga ega bo'lishi (xatda ko'rsatish)

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlarni bajarish uchun kamida 10 nafar mutaxassis bo'lishi va buni xat yoki buyruqlar bilan tasdiqlash kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At least 10 specialists must be available, confirmed by a letter or orders.
requirements.quote: kamida 10 nafar mutaxassis bo'lishi (xatda tasdiqlash / buyruqlarni ilova qilish)

requirements.summary_uz: ISO 9001 sertifikati mavjud bo'lishi talab qilinadi.
requirements.quote: ISO 9001 sertifikati mavjudligi. - Montaj ishlari davomida moddiy zarar yetkazilgan taqdirda

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'sis etilganiga 3 yildan kam bo'lgan ishtirokchi tenderdan chetlashtiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: A bidder established less than 3 years ago is excluded.
requirements.quote: ta'sis etilgan muddati 3 yildan kam bo'lsa

requirements.summary_uz: 30 foiz avans, 65 foiz bajarilgan ishlar dalolatnomasi bo'yicha; qolgan 5 foiz kafolat davridagi xizmatdan keyin to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 30 percent advance, 65 percent on acceptance of completed work; the last 5 percent is paid after warranty service.
requirements.quote: miqdori bo'nak summasini ushlab qolgan xolda bajarilgan ishlar dalolatnomasiga ko'ra amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Taklif kafolati sifatida boshlang'ich narxning 3 foizi (taxminan 104,7 mln so'm) talab qilinadi; g'olib shartnoma summasining 3 foizini ham o'tkazadi.
requirements.summary_en: A bid guarantee of 3 percent of the start price (about 104.7 million UZS) is required; the winner also pays 3 percent of the contract sum.
requirements.quote: summasining 3 foizi miqdorida mablag'lami XKKPning tegishli hisobraqamiga o'tkazib beradi

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha ishlar avans to'langan kundan boshlab 90 kalendar kun ichida tugallanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: All work must be finished within 90 calendar days from the advance payment.
requirements.quote: bo'nak (avans) to'lovi amalga oshirilgan kundan boshlab 90

requirements.summary_uz: Bajarilgan ishlar va uskunalarga kamida 2 yil kafolat beriladi, kafolat davrida ehtiyot qismlar bepul almashtiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: At least 2 years' warranty on work and equipment, with free replacement of parts during the warranty.
requirements.quote: kamida 2 yil bo'lib, kafolat davrida ehtiyot qismlami bepul almashtirishni

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat muddati uchun ball: 5 yil va undan ortiq 5 ball, 2 yil 2 ball, 2 yildan kam 0 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Warranty length is scored: 5 years or more 5 points, 2 years 2 points, under 2 years 0.
requirements.quote: Kafolat muddati (uskunalar va bajarilgan ishlar uchun)

requirements.summary_uz: So'nggi 3 yilda bajarilgan o'xshash loyihalarning jami qiymati lot boshlang'ich narxiga nisbatan baholanadi (100% va undan ko'p 6 ball).
requirements.summary_en: The total value of similar projects in the last 3 years is scored relative to the start price (100 percent or more gets 6 points).
requirements.quote: Oxirgi 3 yilda bajarilgan o’xshash loyihalarning jami qiymati (3-shakl) (lotning boshlang’ich narxiga nisbatan)

requirements.summary_uz: 2026 yildagi bank hisobraqami aylanmasi lot narxiga nisbatan baholanadi (200% va undan ko'p 5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: 2026 bank-account turnover is scored relative to the lot price (200 percent or more gets 5 points).
requirements.quote: 2026-yilda bank asosiy hisobraqamidagi aylanma (lotning boshlang’ich narxiga nisbatan)

flags.quote: ta'sis etilgan muddati 3 yildan kam bo'lsa
flags.explanation_uz: Tender hujjatida ta'sis etilganiga 3 yildan kam bo'lgan ishtirokchi chetlashtirilishi yoziladi (ro'yxatdan o'tganlik guvohnomasi ham 3 yildan kam bo'lmasligi kerak). Yaqinda ochilgan, lekin tajribali mutaxassislari va resurslari bor korxona 3,49 mlrd so'mlik lotda ishtirok eta olmaydi. Tajriba va moliyaviy holat alohida baholanayotgani uchun bu cheklov zarurligini aniqlashtirish kerak.
flags.explanation_en: The tender document excludes bidders established less than 3 years ago (the registration certificate must also be at least 3 years old). A newer company with experienced staff and resources would be shut out of this 3.49 billion UZS lot. Since experience and finances are scored separately, a person should check why this extra gate is needed.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchining tashkil etilgan muddatidan qat'i nazar, tajribasi va resurslari tegishli mezonlar (o'xshash loyihalar, xodimlar, moliyaviy holat) bo'yicha baholanadi.
flags.rewrite_en: Regardless of when the bidder was established, its experience and resources are assessed under the relevant criteria (similar projects, staff, financial position).

reasons_uz: Qatnashish mumkin, lekin avval quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha buyurtmachidan tushuntirish so'rang.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (8-bet): Tender hujjatida ta'sis etilganiga 3 yildan kam bo'lgan ishtirokchi chetlashtirilishi yoziladi (ro'yxatdan o'tganlik guvohnomasi ham 3 yildan kam bo'lmasligi kerak). Yaqinda ochilgan, lekin tajribali mutaxassislari va resurslari bor korxona 3,49 mlrd so'mlik lotda ishtirok eta olmaydi. Tajriba va moliyaviy holat alohida baholanayotgani uchun bu cheklov zarurligini aniqlashtirish kerak.
Diqqat: hujjatning 1 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: Worth bidding, but first ask the customer to clarify the conditions below.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 8): The tender document excludes bidders established less than 3 years ago (the registration certificate must also be at least 3 years old). A newer company with experienced staff and resources would be shut out of this 3.49 billion UZS lot. Since experience and finances are scored separately, a person should check why this extra gate is needed.

documents_needed_uz: Xarid komissiyasi raisi nomiga ishtirok etish arizasi (1-shakl)
Ishtirokchi to'g'risida umumiy ma'lumot va so'nggi 3 yillik tajriba (3-shakl)
Moliyaviy holat to'g'risida ma'lumot va soliq hisobotining 1 va 2-shakllari (4-shakl)
Texnik taklif va texnik tavsiflarning taqqoslama jadvali (6-shakl)
Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi, nizom va ta'sischilar ro'yxati
Yangi uskuna va ehtiyot qismlarning to'liq tavsifi (texnik pasport, sertifikat, broshura)
Uskunalar va montaj ishlari uchun kafolat xati (7-shakl)
2026 yildagi bank hisobraqami aylanmasi to'g'risida bank ma'lumotnomasi
Majburiy ijro byurosi bazasida bajarilmagan majburiyatlar yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
ISO 9001 sertifikati va kamida 10 mutaxassis hamda 3 yillik tajriba haqidagi xat
clarification_letter_uz:
Kimga: MARKAZIY BANKNING FARG`ONA VILOYAT BOSH BOSHQARMASI, xarid komissiyasiga
Lot raqami: 26120012523373
Xarid predmeti: Farg‘ona Markaziy banki ma’muriy binosidagi isitish va sovutish hamda havo almashtirish tizimini yaroqsiz holga kelgan qismlarini sotib olgan holda yangisiga almashtirish orqali kapital ta’mirlash

Hurmatli xarid komissiyasi a'zolari!

Tashkilotimiz mazkur lot bo'yicha xarid hujjatlari bilan tanishib chiqdi va taklif berish niyatida. Hujjatlardagi quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha tushuntirish berishingizni, zarur deb topilgan taqdirda esa ularga tegishli o'zgartirish kiritishingizni so'raymiz.

1. Texnik topshiriq, 8-bet.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «ta'sis etilgan muddati 3 yildan kam bo'lsa»
   Savolimiz: Tender hujjatida ta'sis etilganiga 3 yildan kam bo'lgan ishtirokchi chetlashtirilishi yoziladi (ro'yxatdan o'tganlik guvohnomasi ham 3 yildan kam bo'lmasligi kerak). Yaqinda ochilgan, lekin tajribali mutaxassislari va resurslari bor korxona 3,49 mlrd so'mlik lotda ishtirok eta olmaydi. Tajriba va moliyaviy holat alohida baholanayotgani uchun bu cheklov zarurligini aniqlashtirish kerak.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Ishtirokchining tashkil etilgan muddatidan qat'i nazar, tajribasi va resurslari tegishli mezonlar (o'xshash loyihalar, xodimlar, moliyaviy holat) bo'yicha baholanadi.

Mazkur shartlarga aniqlik kiritilishi xarid predmetini yetkazib bera oladigan barcha ishtirokchilarning teng sharoitda qatnashishiga va raqobatning kengayishiga xizmat qiladi, deb hisoblaymiz.

Javobingizni tushuntirishlar berish muddati tugagunga qadar (20.11.2026 11:10) elektron tizim orqali taqdim etishingizni so'raymiz.
